description: Existing AJ02 candidate trace only. No replay/source changes. These are overlapping intervals during which an earlier-release architecture might unblock CPU; they are not additive saved cycles or a net performance prediction.

milestones.first_output: After first accepted ordinary packet word. Classification/prevalidation has completed, but current implementation can still read/convert later vertices. A complete converted-vertex snapshot could release raw earlier; snapshot latency/cost is not measured here.
milestones.last_vertex_word: After final payload word of the last0x56 vertex packet is accepted. Successful hardware jobs then emit only0x54 indices; this is a conservative observable bound after the final raw vertex read.
milestones.completion: completed_serial transition, after all generated output words are stored; does not imply GPU raster completion.

limitations: Only successful hardware jobs qualify for the two windows; repair jobs excluded. Warm interval has no repair jobs.

Shared FMA usage, packet conversion and memory latency may overlap GPU work. Releasing raw early requires separate legacy/job context and output-controller correctness; no architecture is assumed implemented.
The trace gives remaining generated words and exact aggregate FIFO-full overlaps, but does not expose FIFO read pointer per request. Remaining words are not instantaneous FIFO occupancy.
The after-last-vertex window is a subset of after-first-output. Do not add them. Snapshot filling, tighter FIFO capacity, arbitration, BRAM ports and CPU overhead can consume the apparent headroom.
